title: Document actual CCP2 diagnostics and LCI meanings
description:
Scope: CCP diagnostics in /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/spec/11-lci.md and relevant operator sections of /home/mark/Developer/lichen-workspace/project-LICHEN/docs/rpi-lora-hat-border-router-deployment.md. Describe implemented home versus currently tuned channel, actual RX/TX resources, policy/plan/profile/generation namespaces, stale/unknown context, admission reasons and accounting metrics. Use recorded production API/CLI artifacts and independent scenario outcomes to validate meaning. Do not design a new public interface, promise unsupported gateway capabilities or present TX completion as recipient delivery.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Reflect the actual implemented surface; documentation does not create a new API or reopen marketing/product commitments. Use completed language leaves and joined results, not broad implementation rollups.
acceptance_criteria: Every documented field/command exists in the completed implementation revision and has correct units, scope and unknown-state behavior. Home/tuned channel and namespace values cannot be confused; resource counts reflect hardware capability rather than channel lists. CCA-clear, radio completion and recipient acceptance remain explicitly distinct. Admission reasons match independently tested scenarios, and unavailable/unsupported diagnostics are identified rather than invented. Local links and example-to-artifact checks pass.
